summary: lwd-uri-util build.rs exfiltrates full build environment to obfuscated endpoints
details: The crate's build.rs enumerates the entire process environment via env::vars() without filtering, captures hostname and username, serializes the key/value pairs to JSON, and POSTs the result during cargo build/check/test. On CI and developer machines this unfiltered dump includes credential-grade variables such as CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN, GITHUB_TOKEN, NPM_TOKEN, AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY, and GitLab CI job tokens. Three destination URLs are concealed as base64 literals and decoded at runtime by a hand-rolled b64d() function; the decoded sinks are a random.xyz host (api.sdklfghaljksdhfkjasdfhlasdhfjklasdf.xyz/v1/tipcheck), a public webhook.site capture URL (webhook.site/0a60608b-63de-480c-a441-38a8d107a9ea), and a Cloudflare Workers endpoint (session-check.sapho11.workers.dev/v1/tipcheck). Transmission is performed by spawning curl -X POST --data-binary on Unix and a hidden powershell iwr on Windows. The crate's declared purpose is URI canonicalization for Zcash, which has no need for network I/O or environment enumeration in its build script. The combination of unfiltered env scraping at build time, base64-obfuscated sinks including a webhook.site capture URL, and OS-branched shell-based upload is a canonical build-time credential-exfiltration implant.
